dialogue_texts: Yukari
These woods are quite the eyesore today.
Yukari
The boundary between growth and decay has become so thin it's practically rotting.
Rotting? Oh, you've got it all wrong, eh! It's the golden season! The transformation is just beginning!
Helene
I'm Helene Black, the herald of autumn! Welcome to the forest's most spectacular makeover!
Yukari
A herald of autumn? How quaint.
Yukari
But your "transformation" is smelling a bit too much like that "glohm" filth for my liking.
Helene
Glohm? Is that some kind of winter chill? I don't care about that!
Helene
You should stop worrying about boundaries and start enjoying the leaves!
Yukari
I'm afraid I'm on a royal inspection.
Yukari
If you're standing between me and the truth at Yumemura...
Yukari
I'll have to erase the boundary between you and the ground.
Helene
Royal inspection? Who are you anyway?
Yukari
You don't seem to recognize me? I'm Queen Yukari, ruler of the Democratic Kingdom of Gensokyo.
Helene
Queen Yukari? You seem to talk so fancy.
Helene
Let me see if your magic can outshine the falling gold!
Yukari
Very well. Let us see how your "autumn" fares against the gaps in reality.
